content:
Falcon generates FPA events when permissions are granted, revoked, denied, or extended by Just-in-time access. For info about Falcon Privileged Access, see
.
There are four FPA events, which all have the same event fields:
FpaJITAccessPermissionGranted: Tracks when Just-in-time access permissions are successfully granted
FpaJITAccessPermissionRevoked: Records when Just-in-time access permissions are revoked
FpaJITAccessPermissionExtended: Monitors when Just-in-time access permission durations are extended
FpaJITAccessPermissionDenied: Captures instances when Just-in-time access permission requests are denied
